sales_forecasting.input: data/processed after cleaning: one row per calendar day
sales_forecasting.aggregation: daily_sales = sum(sales over all stores and product families for each date)
sales_forecasting.closure_days: 25 December inserted with sales = 0 and is_closure_day = 1 (verified absent for every store).
leakage_controls: rolling statistics computed on sales.shift(1), so day t is never included
no future actuals: multi-step forecasts feed predictions back recursively
transactions and row id excluded; oil and promotions only in the advanced model (lagged / known in advance)
